analysis.title: Symbotic Inc. (SYM): 4QFY26 First Take
key_insights: GS sees 4QFY26 results as relatively solid. EBITDA results and guidance are moderately above the Street (FactSet), while 1QFY27 revenue guidance is below consensus.
10-K backlog comments imply about $3.6 bn recognized in FY27, in line with consensus FY27 revenue. GS says this explains the muted initial aftermarket reaction.
4QFY26 revenue was $778 mn (+26% yoy, +8% qoq), near the top of the $760-780 mn guidance range and in line with GS ($778 mn) and Street ($774 mn).
Non-GAAP EBITDA ex-SBC was $114 mn vs GS $105 mn, Street $104 mn and guidance of $100-105 mn. Adjusted gross margin was 24.8% vs 25.0% in 3QFY26 and 22.1% in 4QFY25.
FCF was roughly $353 mn in the quarter. Backlog slipped to $22.3 bn from $22.5 bn last quarter, with 16% expected to be recognized over the next 12 months.
Symbotic and Walmart announced an expanded commercial agreement covering 25 US regional distribution centers, with an initial commitment of about $6 bn in spend over several years.
1QFY27 guidance: revenue $805-825 mn vs GS $837 mn and Street $822 mn. Adjusted EBITDA $110-120 mn vs GS $117 mn and Street $109 mn.
GS keeps a Sell rating and $42 12-month target, based on 50x FY28 EBITDA. The stock was $31.10 at the 20 Nov close, implying 35% upside to the target despite the Sell rating.
Call focus items: the Walmart expanded agreement, Exol and Symbotic customer engagements, system starts, margins, and FCF and capital allocation.

market_movers.rationale: EBITDA beat and guide above Street, but valuation at 50x FY28 EBITDA remains rich in GS's view. 1QFY27 revenue guide is below consensus.

earnings_insights: 4QFY26 (Sept) revenue reported $778 mn vs GS $778 mn and Street (FactSet) est $774 mn.
4QFY26 non-GAAP EBITDA ex-SBC reported $114 mn vs GS est $105 mn, Street est $104 mn and guidance $100-105 mn.
4QFY26 non-GAAP EPS ex-SBC reported $0.17. First time the company provided a non-GAAP EPS bridge in the release.
1QFY27 (Dec) guidance: revenue $805-825 mn vs GS est $837 mn and Street est $822 mn. Adjusted EBITDA $110-120 mn vs GS est $117 mn and Street est $109 mn.
GS forecasts FY26E revenue $2,804.9 mn and EBITDA $139.0 mn. FY27E revenue $3,588.0 mn, EBITDA $317.3 mn and EPS $0.35. FY28E revenue $4,127.0 mn, EBITDA $477.3 mn and EPS $0.55.
risk_factors: Upside risks to the Sell view: faster customer wins, especially new customers.
Upside risks to the Sell view: faster system manufacturing and installation.
Upside risks to the Sell view: acceleration of warehouse automation investment.
Upside risks to the Sell view: faster margin improvement or more fixed cost leverage than GS expects.
